proposals.evidence: DEDR 990 full article (p. 94) gives 990 (a) Ta. oru (before consonant), ōr (before vowel) one; ori (-pp-, -tt-) to be united in harmony; orukkam oneness, sameness; orukka for each; orukku (orukki-) to bring together; oruṅku a Bhat ori “single person” matches Lindgren Koraga ori “man” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 988 full article (p. 94) gives Kor. (M. T.) orle id. From DEDS(N) 75. Bhat orle “white ant” is the same cited Koraga form and sense; its original dialect:Koraga:mudu:Mudu uncertain dialect tag is retained. The article is used as family classification, not an independent second attestation of Bhat.
